_comment: Main-Suite Green Guardian stage authority (spec main-suite-green-guardian.md L3). This repo file is the ONLY stage source; the registry never stores stage. On an unreadable/malformed file the guardian falls back to Stage 0 / shadow. Effective stage = min(this stage, what the live trust-policy dial permits) — the dial always wins (conservative->1, balanced->2, loose->3). Graduation flips `stage` via a config-only PR (Check-V pattern); never guardian-self-written. Added to config/deep-review-paths.json so any change is human-reviewed.
